title: Put Out the Little Fires
style: Cinematic acoustic folk-pop with a clear contrast between intimate, slow morning verses and urgent, fast-driving choruses. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, warm piano, restrained brushed percussion in the verses; choruses surge with brisk kick and snare, pulsing bass, strummed guitars, and concise brass lifts. A sunlit, gently playful bridge eases into the final chorus. Male lead vocal, plainspoken and expressive, close-miked verses opening into energetic, rhythmic high-register choruses. Warm organic production with subtle electronic accents. End with a brief, clearly spoken reflective coda over sparse piano.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wake where the curtains let the morning in
My little dream apartment, quiet as a held breath
Coffee curls beside the skillet, bacon starts to sing
Eggs, avocado on toast; the day can wait a bit
I scroll past dances, jokes, the things folks pass around
Then set my phone face down and taste the hush

[Chorus]
Put out the little fires, answer, reroute, reassure
One more urgent message, one more fix before the next
I’m balancing the burning bits from somewhere far away
Click, call, reply—keep the whole small world from spilling out
Put out the little fires, keep the promise, keep it moving
Then I’ll find my way back to the quiet when they’re through

[Verse 2]
At last the kitchen settles; lunch is still ahead
My cats are keeping company, inspecting every step
I chop and stir with care, take time to season well
In my dream kitchen, even noon feels kind
A bowl, a plate, a little flourish just for me
I let the ordinary turn into a treat

[Chorus]
Put out the little fires, answer, reroute, reassure
One more urgent message, one more fix before the next
I’m balancing the burning bits from somewhere far away
Click, call, reply—keep the whole small world from spilling out
Put out the little fires, keep the promise, keep it moving
Then I’ll find my way back to the quiet when they’re through

[Bridge]
The sun lays gold across the floor beside my chair
I play a little game; the cats blink from the sill
No clock can hurry this warm patch of afternoon
For once, my home is all the answer that I need

[Final Chorus]
Put out the little fires, answer, reroute, reassure
One more urgent message, one more fix before the next
I’m balancing the burning bits from somewhere far away
Click, call, reply—keep the whole small world from spilling out
Put out the little fires, keep the promise, keep it moving
Then I’ll find my way back to the quiet when they’re through

[Spoken Outro]
And when the day finally loosens its grip, I think of my friends.
I hope they found a little calm today, too.
I’ll send them a message after lunch.
